messages:
maria: Quick sprint update — hit milestone for continuous-batching perf target (P0). Canary ran overnight, tail latency down ~18% on small-seq workloads. Main open items: kernel mem leak on rollover (ownership?), KV prefetch tuning, and a failing CR that blocks canary rollout. Paging owners for quick decisions. TL;DR: need one reviewer for CR#4321, confirm who owns kernel rollover fix, and decide whether to enable new prefix-cache in canary. cc @ajay @cory @tina

ajay: Nice! I can take CR#4321 review today. For kernel rollover leak — I think ownership is split: runtime-kernel team owns logic, eng-infra owns the allocator patch. @oliver correct me.

cory: Taking the review now. expecting ~30-45m. If it's small I can approve. Any perf regressions in the bench?

tina: deploy-bot posted canary results this AM — link: https://canary.redwood/2001. Metrics: p95 down, p99 neutral. But there was a small OOM on one canary host around 03:12 UTC. Logs point to kv-warmup spiking mem.

infra-bot: Canary run 2001 completed. p50: 12ms, p95: 48ms, p99: 210ms. Host id i-03a... reported OOM at 2026-10-12T03:12:07Z. Artifact: s3://canaries/2001/logs/oom-03-12.log

maria: Thanks. For ownership: runtime-kernel should own the fix but infra will own validation and backstop. So Ajay, can you coordinate with infra for allocator knobs? If we can't roll the prefix-cache, fallback is old cache + batching tweak. Decision by EOD please.

ajay: Will sync with infra in ~15. Also quick Q: should we flip prefix-cache via runtime flag or rollout via config server? I'm leaning runtime flag first to speed testing.

oliver: infra can validate allocator knobs. Also recommend we enable `KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT=8` in canary before prefix-cache. Small code snippet for testing:

```
# canary env
KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT=8
BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024
```

Will avoid mem spike.

cory: noted. I see one TODO in CR — a missing close on buffer in kernel/rollover.cpp. If that's the leak, patch is tiny. I'll add inline comment and ping Ajay.

tina: if Ajay and infra confirm KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT change, I'll redeploy canary config and rerun smoke. :thumbsup: 

maria: Ownership clarified: runtime-kernel (Ajay/Cory) will patch rollover; eng-infra (Oliver/Tina) will validate allocator + canary config. CR#4321 reviewer: Cory. Timeline: review + patch within 3 hours, canary redeploy after infra validation, wide rollout next day if stable. I'll update the sprint board.

ajay: taking action. Ping me in here if infra needs anything. assigning myself to the kernel patch.

cory: PR updated with buffer close fix, pushed to `fix/rollover-close`. Tests pass locally. link: https://git.redwood/pr/4321. @ajay please take a quick look.

infra-bot: Canary redeploy scheduled at 2026-10-12T07:00:00Z after manual approval.

tina: approved for redeploy once Ajay confirms knob set. I'll watch logs.

maria: Awesome. One last ask: add one line to the rollout plan noting fallback to 'no-prefix-cache + BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512' if OOM reoccurs. I'll pin in the ticket.

ajay: done — added rollback note to ticket #987. :memo: 

cory: LGTM. Will follow up post-canary with a short postmortem if we see instability.

maria: Thanks all. Quick standup — will hand off to eng-runtime triage channel if anything pops. :eyes:
